This line is causing confusion. Uniquely does not mean there is only one sensor in the suite. It means that no other suite contains that sensor.
    <criterion>Instrument reference match: Does the named instrument or sensor correspond directly to the proposed match? Matches to a parent suite are acceptable only when that suite uniquely contains the named sensor; otherwise, mismatched or sibling instruments are INVALID.</criterion>
Clarify uniquely phrasing.
mini struggled with partial overlap being acceptable. Sort of accepted it but then renegged.
